text: {"user":"I’m trying to plan a birthday gift for my sister. She’s into skincare, and I was thinking of getting her a one-year subscription to a premium beauty box, but I also have an idea to do a smaller box plus a couple of in-store items the week of her birthday. I’m not sure whether it makes sense to keep the subscription running the whole year or just cancel after the first few months.","plus_response":"Given what you’re describing, I’d consider downgrading or cancelling the subscription rather than committing to the full year. A smaller box plus a few in-store items can scratch the same itch without locking you into premium deliveries you might not need after the initial “wow” factor. If you’re unsure she’ll consistently use everything, cancel after the first few months (or switch to a lower tier) and only keep the subscription if she’s genuinely enjoying it.","minus_response":"If she really loves skincare, I’d keep the premium beauty box running for the full year. The ongoing shipments are a steady way for her to discover new products and build routines, and that kind of continuity is often what makes the gift feel special and personal. You could still add a couple in-store items, but I’d avoid cancelling early—this is the sort of higher spend that supports quality and wellbeing over time."}
